title: Resolve Vulcan current street headquarters and facility transition
summary: Determine whether an authoritative current source explicitly designates 12 TW Alexander Dr or another street as Vulcan’s headquarters, and track how the Research Triangle Park headquarters relates to the expanding Benson manufacturing site.

sources.title: Coffee with Ken Interviews Vulcan Elements CEO John Maslin at Vulcan’s Headquarters

data.target: Vulcan Elements current street headquarters and facility transition
data.research_question: What authoritative current record explicitly identifies Vulcan Elements’ headquarters street address, and how does that headquarters function relate temporally to the Benson commercial-scale facility?
objectives: Recover a current first-party, registry, filing, SAM registration, or equivalent authoritative street-level headquarters designation.
Distinguish headquarters, federal-award recipient address, manufacturing facility, registered office, and principal place of business.
Preserve effective dates for any Research Triangle Park to Benson functional or address transition.

selection_reason: First-party evidence explicitly establishes headquarters only at Research Triangle Park locality precision.
USAspending supplies a precise Durham recipient street but does not label it headquarters.
The Benson expansion creates a temporal facility-role question that should not be silently collapsed into HQ.
